title: AAhead Unofficial Telegram
author: Memetrix
long_description: AAhead brings Telegram to New Nintendo 3DS: chats, photos, stickers, voice messages and audio calls, with native touch controls and QR sign-in
preinstall_message: Requires a New Nintendo 3DS, New 3DS XL or New 2DS XL. Original 3DS/2DS models are not supported.
